description: This Kotlin source file defines the DeepLinkLauncherActivity class, which handles specific deep link URIs ('app://rating/show') in an Android application. When the activity is created, it checks the intent data, and if it matches the expected scheme, host, and path, it constructs a RatingInfo model with predefined data and launches the PostPlaybackRatingActivity, passing the rating info as an extra.

classes.name: DeepLinkLauncherActivity
classes.description: An activity that handles deep links with the URI scheme 'app://rating/show'. It constructs a RatingInfo object with sample data and starts another activity to display ratings based on the deep link.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Overrides AppCompatActivity's onCreate method; initializes activity, checks intent URI, creates RatingInfo if URI matches, and starts the rating display activity.
